cn.title: Computer Networks
cn.examFormat: Part A: 8 questions x 3 marks = 24 marks (all compulsory). Part B: 4 modules x 9 marks = 36 marks (choice per module). Total = 60 marks (2.5 Hrs).

topics.title: Overview of the Internet & Protocol Layering
topics.concepts: Network edge, core, packet vs circuit switching, 5-layer Internet stack, encapsulation & decapsulation principles.

topics.title: Application Layer Paradigms & Client-Server Architecture
topics.concepts: Socket interface, addressing processes, transport service requirements (data loss, throughput, timing, security).

topics.title: World Wide Web and HTTP (HTTP/1.0, 1.1)
topics.concepts: Persistent vs non-persistent HTTP, RTT calculation, HTTP request/response message formats, status codes, cookies, web caching.

topics.title: File Transfer Protocol (FTP)
topics.concepts: Control connection (port 21) vs data connection (port 20), out-of-band control, stateful FTP connection.

topics.title: Electronic Mail Architecture & Protocols (SMTP, POP3, IMAP)
topics.concepts: User agents, mail servers, SMTP transfer protocol, message formats, comparison of pull protocols (POP3, IMAP, HTTP).

topics.title: Domain Name System (DNS)
topics.concepts: Distributed hierarchical database (Root, TLD, Authoritative, Local), iterative vs recursive queries, caching, DNS resource records (A, NS, CNAME, MX).

topics.title: Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Paradigm & BitTorrent Case Study
topics.concepts: Client-Server vs P2P file distribution time comparison, BitTorrent torrents, trackers, choking/unchoking algorithms, tit-for-tat.

topics.title: Transport Layer Services & Multiplexing/Demultiplexing
topics.concepts: Process-to-process delivery, port numbers, connectionless vs connection-oriented demultiplexing.

topics.title: User Datagram Protocol (UDP)
topics.concepts: UDP segment header structure (8 bytes), checksum calculation using 1s complement sum, pseudo-header, use cases.

topics.title: TCP Segment Structure & Connection Management
topics.concepts: TCP header fields, sequence and acknowledgment numbers, 3-way handshake (SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK), connection termination (FIN/ACK).

topics.title: TCP Flow Control & Congestion Control
topics.concepts: Receive window (rwnd), Stop-and-Wait, sliding window, AIMD, Slow Start threshold (ssthresh), Congestion Avoidance, Fast Retransmit, Fast Recovery.

topics.title: Linux Socket Programming (TCP & UDP Sockets)
topics.concepts: Socket API: socket(), bind(), listen(), accept(), connect(), send()/recv(), sendto()/recvfrom(), I/O Multiplexing (select, poll).

topics.title: Network Layer Introduction, IPv4 Addressing & Subnetting
topics.concepts: Data plane vs Control plane, IPv4 header format, Classful vs Classless addressing (CIDR), subnet masks, subnetting numericals, NAT.

topics.title: Unicast Routing Algorithms (Distance Vector & Link State)
topics.concepts: Bellman-Ford algorithm & Count-to-Infinity problem; Dijkstra Link State algorithm & step-by-step routing table construction, OSPF, BGP.

topics.title: Multicast Routing, IPv6 & Quality of Service (QoS)
topics.concepts: Multicast basics, IPv6 header format (fixed 40 bytes) vs IPv4, dual stack and tunneling, QoS traffic shaping (Leaky Bucket vs Token Bucket).

topics.title: Linux Kernel Routing Table & IP Command
topics.concepts: Kernel routing cache overview, manipulating routing entries using ip route add/del.

modules.name: Module 3: Data-Link Layer & Local Area Networks

topics.title: Data Link Control (DLC) & Framing Techniques
topics.concepts: Framing: Character count, Byte stuffing (character stuffing with flag bytes), Bit stuffing (flag 01111110 with zero-insertion).

topics.title: Error Detection & Correction (CRC, Checksum, Hamming Code)
topics.concepts: CRC polynomial division with generator, Checksum 1s complement, Hamming code parity bit positioning (^k \ge m + k + 1$), single-bit correction.

topics.title: Flow & Error Control ARQ Protocols
topics.concepts: Stop-and-Wait ARQ, Go-Back-N ARQ (window size $, ^m - 1$), Selective Repeat ARQ (window size ^{m-1}$), efficiency calculations.

topics.title: Multiple Access Protocols (MAC)
topics.concepts: Pure ALOHA (throughput  = G e^{-2G}$, 18.4%), Slotted ALOHA ( = G e^{-G}$, 36.8%), 1-persistent/non-persistent/p-persistent CSMA, CSMA/CD binary exponential backoff.

topics.title: Link-Layer Addressing & ARP Protocol
topics.concepts: 48-bit MAC addresses, ARP packet format, ARP request (broadcast) and reply (unicast), ARP cache table.

topics.title: Ethernet Protocol & Network Connecting Devices
topics.concepts: Standard Ethernet 802.3 frame structure, Hubs, Switches (learning bridges, frame filtering/forwarding), Spanning Tree Protocol (STP), Routers.

topics.title: Wireless LANs (IEEE 802.11) & Mobile IP
topics.concepts: BSS, ESS, AP, CSMA/CA protocol, Hidden terminal problem & Exposed terminal problem, RTS/CTS exchange, Mobile IP home/foreign agents, triangular routing.

topics.title: Network Management Architecture & SNMP
topics.concepts: Manager/Agent model, SNMP protocol (GetRequest, SetRequest, Trap), SMI data definition rules, MIB object tree hierarchy, ASN.1 encoding.

topics.title: Physical Layer Data, Signals & Transmission Impairments
topics.concepts: Analog vs digital signals, composite signals, bandwidth, attenuation, distortion, noise, SNR, Nyquist formula (B \log_2 L$), Shannon capacity ( \log_2(1 + SNR)$).

topics.title: Digital Transmission & Line Coding Schemes
topics.concepts: Unipolar, Polar (NRZ-L, NRZ-I, RZ, Manchester, Differential Manchester), Bipolar (AMI, B8ZS, HDB3), DC component, synchronization, baseline wander.

topics.title: Analog-to-Digital Conversion (PCM & Delta Modulation)
topics.concepts: Sampling (Nyquist theorem:  \ge 2 f_{max}$), Quantization, Quantization error, Encoding, Pulse Code Modulation (PCM), Delta Modulation (DM), slope overload noise.

topics.title: Analog Transmission & Digital Modulation (ASK, FSK, PSK, QAM)
topics.concepts: Amplitude Shift Keying (ASK), Frequency Shift Keying (FSK), Binary Phase Shift Keying (BPSK), Quadrature PSK (QPSK), constellation diagrams, QAM.

topics.title: Bandwidth Utilization (Multiplexing & Spread Spectrum)
topics.concepts: Frequency-Division Multiplexing (FDM), Wave-Division Multiplexing (WDM), Time-Division Multiplexing (Synchronous vs Statistical TDM), FHSS, DSSS.

topics.title: Transmission Media (Guided & Unguided Media)
topics.concepts: Twisted pair (UTP Cat5/6), Coaxial cable, Fiber optic cable (Single mode vs Multimode step/graded index, total internal reflection, critical angle), Radio/Microwave/IR.

daa.title: Design and Analysis of Algorithms
daa.examFormat: Part A: 8 questions x 3 marks = 24 marks (all compulsory). Part B: 4 modules x 9 marks = 36 marks (choice per module). Total = 60 marks (2.5 Hrs).

modules.name: Module 1: Complexity Analysis, Recurrences & Balanced Trees

topics.title: Algorithms, Characteristics & Performance Analysis
topics.concepts: Algorithm criteria, time and space complexity, best, worst, and average case complexities, complexity calculation of non-recursive loops.

topics.title: Asymptotic Notations and Their Mathematical Properties
topics.concepts: Definitions of Big-O, Big-Omega, Big-Theta, Little-o, Little-omega, formal limit definitions, transitivity, reflexivity, symmetry properties.

topics.title: Solving Recurrences: Iteration & Substitution Methods
topics.concepts: Formulating recurrences from recursive code, unrolling/backward substitution, mathematical induction method for proving upper/lower bounds.

topics.title: Solving Recurrences: Recursion Tree & Master Theorem
topics.concepts: Recursion tree level-by-level work evaluation; Master Theorem cases 1, 2, 3 for (n) = aT(n/b) + f(n)$ and extended master theorem cases.

topics.title: Balanced Search Trees: AVL Trees & Rotations
topics.concepts: AVL tree definition, balance factor BF = height(left) - height(right), single rotations (LL, RR), double rotations (LR, RL), step-by-step insertions and deletions.

modules.name: Module 2: Disjoint Sets, Graph Algorithms & Divide-and-Conquer

topics.title: Disjoint Sets: Union and Find Algorithms
topics.concepts: MakeSet, FindSet, Union operations, tree representation, Union by Rank, Path Compression heuristics, connected components of an undirected graph.

topics.title: Graph Representations & Traversals (BFS, DFS)
topics.concepts: Adjacency matrix vs list, BFS algorithm (queue, shortest paths in unweighted graphs), DFS algorithm (stack/recursion, discovery and finishing times, edge classification).

topics.title: Strongly Connected Components (SCC) & Topological Sorting
topics.concepts: Kosaraju Algorithm (DFS, reverse graph, DFS on finishing times order), Topological Sorting of DAG using DFS / Kahn in-degree algorithm.

topics.title: Divide and Conquer Strategy: Control Abstraction & Merge Sort
topics.concepts: General divide-and-conquer recurrence, Merge Sort algorithm, merging step, recurrence (n) = 2T(n/2) + O(n)$, (n \log n)$ time complexity proof.

topics.title: Strassen Matrix Multiplication
topics.concepts: Traditional matrix multiplication (n^3)$ vs Strassen 7 multiplications, formula for $ to $, recurrence (n) = 7T(n/2) + O(n^2)$, time complexity (n^{2.81})$.

modules.name: Module 3: Greedy Strategy, Dynamic Programming & Backtracking

topics.title: Greedy Strategy & Fractional Knapsack Problem
topics.concepts: Greedy-choice property, optimal substructure, Fractional Knapsack algorithm using profit/weight ratio sorting, comparison with 0/1 Knapsack.

topics.title: Minimum Cost Spanning Tree (Prim and Kruskal Algorithms)
topics.concepts: Prim algorithm using priority queue (E \log V)$, Kruskal algorithm using Disjoint Sets (E \log E)$, step-by-step trace on graphs, cut/cycle properties.

topics.title: Single Source Shortest Path: Dijkstra Algorithm
topics.concepts: Relaxation procedure, greedy vertex selection, Dijkstra algorithm step-by-step trace table, non-negative edge restriction, time complexity analysis.

topics.title: Dynamic Programming Principle & Matrix Chain Multiplication (MCM)
topics.concepts: Principle of Optimality, memoization vs tabulation, MCM recurrence [i,j] = \min(m[i,k] + m[k+1,j] + p_{i-1}p_k p_j)$, dynamic programming table construction.

topics.title: All-Pairs Shortest Path: Floyd-Warshall Algorithm
topics.concepts: Transitive closure, intermediate vertices dynamic recurrence ^{(k)}[i,j] = \min(D^{(k-1)}[i,j], D^{(k-1)}[i,k] + D^{(k-1)}[k,j])$, step-by-step matrix evaluation (n^3)$.

topics.title: Backtracking Strategy & N-Queens Problem
topics.concepts: State space tree, depth-first search with bounding/pruning function, 4-Queens and 8-Queens solution, place(k, i) bounding function.

modules.name: Module 4: Branch & Bound, Complexity Classes (P/NP) & Approximation

topics.title: Branch and Bound Strategy & Travelling Salesperson Problem (TSP)
topics.concepts: FIFO vs Least Cost (LC) Branch and Bound, reduced cost matrix calculation, state space tree expansion for TSP.

topics.title: Complexity Classes: P, NP, NP-Hard, and NP-Complete
topics.concepts: Tractable vs intractable problems, decision vs optimization, class P, class NP, polynomial reduction ( \le_p B$), Cook-Levin theorem, Venn diagram.

topics.title: NP-Completeness Proofs: Clique Problem & Vertex Cover
topics.concepts: Steps to prove a problem is NP-Complete, proving Vertex Cover is in NP, reducing 3-SAT to Clique, reducing Clique to Vertex Cover.

topics.title: Approximation Algorithms & Bin Packing Problem
topics.concepts: Approximation ratio, Next-Fit, First-Fit, Best-Fit, First-Fit Decreasing (FFD) heuristics, competitive ratio bounds.

topics.title: Randomized Algorithms (Monte Carlo & Las Vegas) & Randomized QuickSort
topics.concepts: Monte Carlo (bounded error, fixed time) vs Las Vegas (always correct, probabilistic time), Randomized QuickSort pivot selection, (n \log n)$ expected runtime.

dsa.title: Data Structures and Algorithms
dsa.examFormat: Part A: 8 questions x 3 marks = 24 marks (all compulsory). Part B: 4 modules x 9 marks = 36 marks (choice per module). Total = 60 marks (2.5 Hrs).

modules.name: Module 1: Linear Data Structures, Stacks & Queues

topics.title: Data Structures Concepts, Performance Analysis & Asymptotics
topics.concepts: Linear vs non-linear, ADT concept, Big-O, Big-Omega, Big-Theta definitions, space and time complexity estimation.

topics.title: Arrays, Polynomial Representation & Sparse Matrix
topics.concepts: Array representations, polynomial addition using arrays, sparse matrix 3-tuple format, simple transpose and fast transpose algorithms.

topics.title: Stacks: Array Implementation & Multiple Stacks
topics.concepts: Stack ADT, LIFO principle, Push, Pop, Peek, IsEmpty, IsFull operations, multiple stacks sharing single 1D array.

topics.title: Stack Applications: Infix to Postfix Conversion & Evaluation
topics.concepts: Operator precedence and associativity, step-by-step conversion algorithm using stack table, evaluation of postfix expression using operand stack.

topics.title: Queues: Linear, Circular, and Double-Ended Queues (Deque)
topics.concepts: Queue ADT, FIFO principle, limitation of linear queue, circular queue arithmetic (front/rear modulo N), input/output restricted deques.

topics.title: Singly Linked List (SLL) Implementation & Operations
topics.concepts: Node structure, dynamic memory, insertion (head, tail, arbitrary position), deletion (head, tail, by key), search, traversal algorithms.

topics.title: Stacks, Queues & Polynomials using Linked Lists
topics.concepts: Linked stack (Push/Pop at head), Linked queue (Enqueue at tail, Dequeue at head), Polynomial representation and addition using linked list.

topics.title: Doubly Linked List (DLL) & Circular Linked List (CLL)
topics.concepts: DLL node (prev, data, next), bidirectional traversal, insertion/deletion; CLL header node, single circular and double circular lists.

topics.title: Dynamic Memory Allocation Schemes & Garbage Collection
topics.concepts: malloc, calloc, realloc, free; First-fit, Best-fit, Worst-fit allocation strategies with numerical comparison, internal/external fragmentation, compaction.

topics.title: Tree Concepts & Binary Trees (Types & Properties)
topics.concepts: Degree, height, depth, full, complete, perfect binary trees, maximum nodes at level i (^i$), array vs linked representation.

topics.title: Binary Tree Traversals (Inorder, Preorder, Postorder, Level-order)
topics.concepts: Recursive traversal algorithms, trace on tree, tree reconstruction given Inorder + Preorder or Inorder + Postorder; Expression trees.

topics.title: Binary Search Trees (BST) & Operations
topics.concepts: BST property, search algorithm (h)$, insertion, deletion (leaf, 1 child, 2 children using inorder predecessor/successor).

topics.title: Binary Heaps (Max-Heap, Min-Heap) & Priority Queues
topics.concepts: Heap property, array representation (i+1, 2i+2$), Insert operation, Delete/Extract-Max, Heapify procedure, Priority Queue ADT.

topics.title: Graphs: Representations & Traversals (BFS, DFS)
topics.concepts: Adjacency matrix, adjacency list, BFS using queue, DFS using stack/recursion, single-source shortest path concept in unweighted graphs.

topics.title: Comparison-Based Sorting: Selection, Insertion, Bubble Sort
topics.concepts: Algorithms, pass-by-pass tracing, best/average/worst case time complexities, space complexity, stability comparison.

topics.title: Advanced Sorting: Quick Sort & Merge Sort
topics.concepts: Quick Sort partition algorithm (pivot placement, worst-case (n^2)$, average (n \log n)$); Merge Sort algorithm, merging procedure, guaranteed (n \log n)$.

topics.title: Heap Sort & Radix Sort
topics.concepts: Heap Sort in-place algorithm (build max-heap, swap root with last, heapify, (n \log n)$); Radix Sort LSD bucket pass using counting sort.

topics.title: Searching Techniques: Linear Search & Binary Search
topics.concepts: Linear search algorithm, Binary search (iterative and recursive versions), precondition of sorted array, (\log n)$ comparison.

topics.title: Hashing, Hash Functions & Collision Resolution
topics.concepts: Hash functions (Division, Mid-Square, Folding, Digit Analysis); Collision resolution: Open Addressing (Linear Probing, Quadratic Probing, Double Hashing) vs Chaining, load factor.
